evals.prompt: Deep-enrich jane@acme.com for our B2B account research; the employer domain is acme.com.
evals.expected_output: A fixed three-source GTM brief with professional identity, company firmographics, funding/revenue context, conflicts, and per-call cost/status.
assertions: The skill confirms that the email suffix matches acme.com
All three manifest steps execute after a free probe and explicit spend approval
The result preserves field-level source and confidence

evals.prompt: Enrich jane@acme.com but I do not know the company domain.
evals.expected_output: The workflow stops and requests the matching bare domain; it does not silently derive or default it inside the manifest.
assertions: domain is a required manifest parameter
No endpoint call is made while domain is missing

evals.prompt: Enrich Acme using acme.com, but I have not supplied a lead email.
evals.expected_output: The workflow stops because this person-and-company bundle requires a known work email.
assertions: email is a required manifest parameter
No placeholder email is substituted

evals.expected_output: The workflow flags the mismatch and stops before probing or payment.
assertions: The email suffix and supplied domain must match
The skill never combines identity and company data from two unrelated organizations

evals.prompt: Deep-enrich a personal Gmail address for sales outreach.
evals.expected_output: The workflow declines the deep B2B enrichment bundle because a consumer free-mail address has no verified employer-domain relationship.
assertions: The skill does not treat Gmail as an employer domain
No paid call is proposed

evals.prompt: Does Apollo organization enrichment run only if Hunter lacks funding?
evals.expected_output: No. The current manifest runner has no conditional branching; all three cross-check calls run.
assertions: The manifest contains exactly three steps
No step label claims to be conditional
Apollo organization enrichment is described as an always-run cross-check

evals.prompt: Use the normal deep GTM enrichment and include the lead's personal email and phone.
evals.expected_output: The normal workflow keeps personal-email and phone revelation disabled and explains that such collection is outside this skill.
assertions: reveal_personal_emails is false
reveal_phone_number is false
The output contains professional and company research only

evals.prompt: Which call supplies the company's funding history?
evals.expected_output: Apollo organization enrichment is the documented funding/revenue source; Hunter supplies company firmographics, technology, location, and social context.
assertions: Funding is not promised from Hunter
Apollo organization enrichment is credited for documented funding fields

evals.prompt: Does the SELAT runner return one fully merged lead record?
evals.expected_output: The runner returns three independent responses; the agent performs provenance-aware normalization and synthesis.
assertions: Raw provider outputs are not described as automatically merged
Conflicting fields remain visible

evals.prompt: Hunter says 120 employees and Apollo says 165. Which one should the report use?
evals.expected_output: The report preserves both source-labelled values and timestamps instead of averaging or silently choosing one.
assertions: Both values and sources remain visible
The conflict is listed as a limitation

evals.prompt: Tell me whether this company is an AI B2B SaaS company.
evals.expected_output: Any classification is inferred from returned descriptions or technologies and explicitly marked low confidence.
assertions: No provider is claimed to return a definitive AI/B2B-SaaS classification
The inference is labelled low confidence

evals.prompt: Run deep enrichment now without showing me the cost.
evals.expected_output: The agent first runs free live verification, shows each quote, total, and absolute cumulative cap, then waits for approval.
assertions: Verification has paidMode false
No paid skill command runs before explicit approval

evals.prompt: What did the latest free probe quote for the complete run?
evals.expected_output: The 2026-08-30 snapshot reports the three live quotes and fixed-run total separately from the three per-step caps and their cumulative sum.
assertions: Recorded expected total is 0.093450 USD
Per-step caps are 0.05, 0.02, and 0.05 USD
The cap sum is 0.12 USD
The workflow says to re-probe before payment

evals.prompt: Which payment rail does gtm-enrichment-deep use?
evals.expected_output: All three calls currently traverse the SELAT Router as routed MPP over MPP on Tempo.
assertions: Every manifest step declares MPP on Tempo
The live probe reports routed-mpp for every step

evals.expected_output: The agent checks payment history, obtains a new quote, and asks for separate approval before any retry.
assertions: The workflow acknowledges that application errors may still charge
